title: The Real Reason You Feel a 'Runner's High' After Exercise
hook: Feeling great after intense exercise is not just about endorphins.

narration.text: Feeling great after intense exercise is not just about endorphins.
Your brain actually releases endocannabinoids, similar to compounds found in cannabis.
These are natural mood enhancers that reduce pain and anxiety.
They create that sense of well-being and euphoria.
This effect is more pronounced after sustained, moderate-to-intense activity.
It helps explain why exercise can be a powerful stress reliever.
What physical activities make you feel the best?

description: Ever wondered why you feel so good after a tough workout? It turns out, there's more to the 'runner's high' than just endorphins. Your body produces natural mood-boosting compounds.
topic: Why you experience a 'runner's high' after intense exercise.
